analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem reported a 34.58% YoY increase in quarterly revenue to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% YoY growth in Profit After Tax to ₹47.06 crore for Q1 FY27. Expanded capacities at Meghnagar, including NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA, are contributing progressively to performance. Through its parent group OGI, the company secured a 10-year Green Ammonia Purchase Agreement for 70,000 MTPA with SECI. Management targets expanding its market share from 18% to 25% within 2-3 years and maintaining DAP/NPK capacity utilization above 80%. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported full-year FY26 revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver over 40% growth across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: For FY27, the company expects to import approximately 150,000 metric tons of material, generating around Rs. 1,000 crore in revenue.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

guidance.claim: Krishana Phoschem targets overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects benefits from expanded capacity to meaningfully reflect in performance starting FY27.
guidance.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth due to strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 experienced stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: The monsoon forecast stands at approximately 95% of normal.
demand_outlook.quote: The monsoon forecast is around 95% of normal, which is not a major variation.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA are now contributing to company performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced its NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Sulphuric acid capacity was expanded to 99,000 MTPA to strengthen backward integration.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that no additional expansion plans are currently planned beyond what has already been implemented.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax reached ₹47.06 crore, up 53.88% YoY due to operational efficiency and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly revenue increased 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore driven by capacity utilization and execution.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly revenue grew 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore, driven by sustained capacity utilization and efficient execution across our integrated value chain.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA reached Rs. 90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: Global input markets saw price increases from mid-February due to supply constraints, tight gas-linked production, and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects profitability to come down slightly in FY27 as it absorbs a portion of higher input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Input prices for sulphur/sulphuric acid fluctuate between Rs. 55,000 and Rs. 70,000 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: The prices are changing and prices are in the range of around Rs.55,000 to Rs.70,000 per ton, depending on the supplier and what time we are buying and what are the payment terms.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed manufacturing capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Krishana Phoschem achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT in Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual fertilizer production for FY26 reached 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Certain NPK/DAP and SSP units operated above 100% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: Maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity, reflecting strong demand and efficient plant operations

orders_capacity.claim: FY26 trading volumes were about 93,000 MT, while manufacturing volumes reached around 383,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: Disciplined capital allocation is one of the five core pillars of Krishana Phoschem's strategic blueprint.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: Capacity expansion was funded using a mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The effective interest cost for borrowings ranges between 6% and 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: For working capital borrowings, rates vary depending on the lending institution and facility structure. Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

capital_allocation.claim: Subsidy receivables were around Rs. 400 crore while other receivables ranged from Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 325 crore at year end.
capital_allocation.quote: Subsidy because we, that import materials we supplied substantially within this last quarter. So, subsidy receivable is almost Rs.400 crore and other receivables are in the range of Rs.300 crore to Rs.325 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fertilizer industry relies on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, exposing cost structures to global price movements.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Firming sulphur prices and slowing domestic demand in March created cost pressure in the closing quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Newly announced government support measures do not fully compensate for the full increase in input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the support announced does not fully offset the increase in input costs, it does provide meaningful relief.

management_commitments.claim: Management expressed confidence in building on current operational momentum through the remainder of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to deliver over 40% growth across key parameters during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Krishana Phoschem expects to import about 150,000 MT of material translating to approximately Rs. 1,000 crore in revenue during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects capacity expansion benefits to reflect meaningfully in performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.
